_comment: VALID on purpose, and specific to this package: 0.4.0 changed the HTTP(S) fields from `format: uri` to `format: iri`, so a publisher may keep the ñ they actually published instead of percent-encoding it into a second spelling of the same identity. The spec's own example (event-iri-url.json) covers id and url; this one adds partOf.id, the third field an identifier can hide in. See spec issue #32.
